advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.text: Select the Skills folder of the project first, as the section "When you select the folder for the Skill" tells you.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md line 11, the technical noun "Skills folder of the project" is not in the base list of technical-terms.md, and only line 73 of the same file defines it.
advisory.correction: Keep the sentence, and add a warning that recommends a glossary entry, for example "**Skills folder**: A Skills folder is the folder `.claude/skills/`, `.agents/skills/`, or `.opencode/skills/` of a project." Or write "Select the folder of the project for all Skills first, as the section "When you select the folder for the Skill" tells you."

advisory.heading: When you select the words and the tone
advisory.text: Select the Skills folder of the project first, as the section "When you select the folder for the Skill" tells you.
advisory.problem: Line 11 of skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md tells the agent to select the Skills folder of the project for each Skill, but line 73 tells the agent to use the Skills folder of the project only when the target platforms include Claude Code and Codex, and lines 75 to 79 give the folder for the other target platforms.
advisory.correction: "Select the folder for the Skill first, as the section "When you select the folder for the Skill" tells you."
